slack.message:
*Northbridge Academy*
An advisor picks up a student case when Maya Chen has waited two days for a course change.
1. Northbridge Academy is the school account, and Maya Chen is the student.
2. A case opens for a course change, waiting on the advisor.
3. The case sits past two days.
4. The case moves to closed when the advisor approves the change.
Tag: [demo-builder:education-advising]

manualSteps.title: Install the Slack app in the workspace
manualSteps.detail: Create a Slack app from slack/manifest.json and install it in the workspace where the demos should appear. Approve it if the workspace requires an admin. Skip this when Demo Publisher is already installed there.

manualSteps.title: Store the bot token where Salesforce can use it
manualSteps.detail: Copy the bot token from the install into a Salesforce named credential for https://slack.com/api. Keep the token out of git and out of the demo spec. Skip this when that credential already exists.

manualSteps.title: Allow a Demos section in the sidebar
manualSteps.detail: Shared sidebar sections need a paid Slack plan and permission to create user groups. In workspace permissions, allow user groups to be created. Skip this when @demos already exists and shows as a sidebar section.

manualSteps.title: Connect the Salesforce org to seed
manualSteps.detail: Sign the coding agent into the Salesforce org that should receive the records and the publisher flow. A demo org is the usual choice. The agent uses whichever org that login opens.

manualSteps.title: Deploy the Salesforce flow that posts to Slack
manualSteps.detail: The flow is an after-save flow on Case. It posts salesforce/slack-post.json when a tagged case is created or its status changes. Deploy it with the Salesforce CLI or Metadata API. Skip this when that flow is already active.

agentSteps.title: Confirm the demo org
agentSteps.detail: Use the Salesforce org this session is signed into. Create the records and the publisher flow there.

agentSteps.title: Channel #education-advising in Demos
agentSteps.detail: In the workspace where Demo Publisher is installed, create #education-advising with conversations.create and invite the bot. Create or update the @demos user group named Demos with enable_section true, and include #education-advising in its default channels. That group is the sidebar section for every demo. Add the person running the demo with usergroups.users.update when you have their Slack user id.

agentSteps.title: Beat 1: Account
agentSteps.detail: Create or update the Account. Northbridge Academy is the school account, and Maya Chen is the student. Tag the Name or Subject, and the Description, with [demo-builder:education-advising]. Use an Industry picklist value the org already has.

agentSteps.title: Beat 2: Case
agentSteps.detail: Create or update the Case. A case opens for a course change, waiting on the advisor. Tag the Name or Subject, and the Description, with [demo-builder:education-advising]. Use an Industry picklist value the org already has.

agentSteps.title: Beat 3: Case
agentSteps.detail: Create or update the Case. The case sits past two days. Tag the Name or Subject, and the Description, with [demo-builder:education-advising]. Use an Industry picklist value the org already has.

agentSteps.title: Beat 4: Case
agentSteps.detail: Create or update the Case. The case moves to closed when the advisor approves the change. Tag the Name or Subject, and the Description, with [demo-builder:education-advising]. Use an Industry picklist value the org already has.

agentSteps.title: Wire Salesforce changes to Slack
agentSteps.detail: Activate an after-save flow on Case for records whose Subject contains [demo-builder:education-advising]. On create and on Status change, POST the body in salesforce/slack-post.json to the channel from this plan. The named credential holds the bot token.

agentSteps.title: Save the spec
agentSteps.detail: Write this plan to demos/education-advising.json with salesforceIds left empty. Put record ids and the Slack channel id only in demos/education-advising.links.json.
